summary: The calculations are correct conditional on two unstated definitions, but the candidate is not verifiable as written because both definitions are essential to the proof.
gaps: The term "compatible" is undefined. The proof requires compatibility to imply (A_0+A_2)/2\subseteq A_1, both in deriving the cover of A_0\times A_2 and in validating the examples, but this implication is neither stated nor supplied as an accepted fact.

The measure \mu is undefined. Equation (10) and the example require the identity \mu(H_r)=b_{r0}+b_{r1}+b_{r2}; this is not ordinary three-dimensional Lebesgue measure and is not established anywhere in the candidate or accepted predecessor facts.
repair_hints: Define compatibility explicitly so that the midpoint-set inclusion used in the proof follows.
Define \mu on halfspaces, including the identity relating it to the three slice-cap areas.
